summary: Iteration 135: Tested Upcoming Meetings and Trending Topics features. All backend endpoints working (100% pass rate). Frontend dashboard displays both new sections correctly - Upcoming shows 5 meetings with Start buttons, Trending Topics shows 5 AI-extracted topics with purple badges. All existing features (stats, collapsible sections, meeting creation, KARAU avatar) remain functional.

issues: All topic badges showing purple/neutral color because API doesn't consistently return sentiment field - not a bug, just LLM inconsistency

Frontend handles missing 'sentiment' field by defaulting to purple/neutral color

All data-testid attributes present for testing: upcoming-meetings, trending-topics, topic-{n}
